record.title: Evaluate stopped waveform and admit the smallest RF comparison continuation
record.intent: Advance toward verification or falsification using waveform evidence rather than running-scope built-ins.
requirements: Reparse exact stopped RAW data and preambles. Report waveform headroom, sampled AC RMS, periodicity/spectrum and default receive qualification with limits. Source spectral quality and calibrated amplitude remain unproved.

Decide whether the discrepancy is resolved enough for a newly declared matched comparison or needs a distinct bounded question. Missing or rejected data remains unassessable, not disproof of1GHz enablement.

If supported, admit one bounded successor comparison batch with the same schedule and original numerical contrast criteria but explicitly justified common display range and hard headroom criteria for every arm. Preserve original protocol/negative outcome, source/cable/stock-native/protected-corpus invariants and one normal reboot per native transition. Plan, inspect, expected-revision admission and commit/push before execution. No physical-state expansion beyond current authorization and deadline.

Stop with an honest determination when evidence verifies or contradicts the declared engineering effect; do not claim continuous calibrated bandwidth from selected-point sampled RMS. If next observation requires new wiring or physical adjustment, record exact operator action rather than guessing.
acceptance: An explicit diagnostic finding and justified continuation or terminal limitation are preserved.
